title: Missing work and safe continuation
body:
1. Publish and reconcile the historical dev8 source baseline in GitHub (from its exact archived bytes), then reconcile the dev9 source delta against it and check repository/source hashes.

2. Obtain ooRexx 5.3.0 r13196 in a reachable execution environment and run tests/run_environment.sh with the declared optional Intention Service / ConnectSelector package paths.

3. Bind verifyArchitectureSscResolution to an actual accepted SSC package-resolution/read-only service and prove negative conditions: missing provider, source level mismatch, duplicate component ID, unresolved ::requires, lineage mismatch, stale plan, forged receipt, changed closure.

4. Model source locks separately from deployment target/native qualifications and produce a Deployment handoff only on independently verified lock and target evidence.

5. Implement NotNotes publication via its native authoritative document API; include exact versioned plan, alternatives, rejected reasons, approvals and dependency evidence.

6. Add cost/resource estimates with confidence, budget limits, jurisdiction, identity and risk constraints, then website/Wire UI projection; UI carries no decision authority.
summary: 1. Publish and reconcile the historical dev8 source baseline in GitHub (from its exact archived bytes), then reconcile the dev9 source delta against it and check repository/source hashes.
invariants: Architecture selection and review never authorize execution
Unknown qualification fails closed and remains visible
Each external component retains its own semantic and provenance authority

provenance.claim: Exact historical baseline; no new runtime acceptance
